name: Consecrated Letter

angles.text: As a paladin, you wield the Holy Light and embody its virtues. In Northshire and beyond, your allies look to you as a beacon of hope.
As a human beginning your service at Northshire Abbey, you are called to act as an honorable symbol in a Kingdom troubled by recent trials.
As an Alliance representative of the Holy Light, you are expected to act with honor and uphold the Alliance’s moral standing and defense.

faq.answer: The Consecrated Letter calls an initiate of the Holy Light in Northshire Valley to begin training. It directs the bearer to a class trainer at Northshire Abbey and recalls their sacred duties.
After a new paladin returns from the kobold camps, someone at Northshire Abbey hands over the letter. Sealed with Brother Sammuel’s insignia, it tells the paladin to come see him.
faq.q: Where does the Consecrated Letter come from?

faq.answer: Brother Sammuel, the paladin trainer near the entrance of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest, receives the letter.
The trainer mentors the initiate in the ways of the Holy Light. They teach martial techniques, defensive blessings, and sacred spells as the initiate gains practical combat experience in the valley.
faq.q: What role does the trainer play after reading the letter?

faq.answer: Those who channel the Holy Light are visible paragons of faith and virtue. Friends and foes alike recognize its power, so their conduct reflects upon the faith itself.
faq.q: Why does the letter mention being a symbol?

aliases: where do i take the letter
faq.answer: Northshire Abbey lies in Elwynn Forest’s peaceful northern valley. It is a sanctuary of faith and the chief grounds for recruiting defenders of the Kingdom of Stormwind.
faq.q: Where does this training take place?

sections.body: In Northshire Valley, the Consecrated Letter begins an initiate’s journey in the Holy Light. It calls those newly arrived to find their trainer at Northshire Abbey. There, they can formalize their instruction and take up their duties in the Kingdom of Stormwind.
sections.title: A Sacred Calling

sections.body: The letter reminds each initiate of the weight of their calling. Those who channel the Holy Light shine before all, symbols of hope to allies and clear targets to adversaries. Their trainer teaches that such power demands discipline. Others will judge the faith by their conduct.
sections.title: Carrying the Light

sections.body: The letter begins a lasting bond between student and mentor. As the initiate tests their mettle against threats around Northshire, they are expected to return often to the abbey grounds. There, their trainer guides them toward deeper understanding of combat and divine grace.
sections.title: Guidance and Discipline

summary: At Northshire Abbey, the Consecrated Letter calls new initiates of the Holy Light to training. It sends each bearer to a class trainer and reminds them that their conduct reflects their faith.
